fields.DESCRIPTION: Bring the warmth of natural wood to your dining experience with this handcrafted wooden serving bowl, made by skilled Rajasthani artisans. Its smooth finish and natural wood grain highlight the rustic beauty of traditional craftsmanship, making it both a functional and decorative piece. Perfect for serving salads, fruits, snacks, or dry items, this eco-friendly bowl is durable, lightweight, and adds an earthy charm to your kitchen and dining table.
